hypothesis: Frozen swept experts improve low-visibility MFT/VFT/ISRJ recall only when a learned advantage gate predicts lower per-sample log loss than the frozen six-class MLCNN.

label_mapping_correction.reason: Legacy swept-isolation reports called output 0 SawFM, but the executable dataset selects global columns 3:6. Routing output 0 to SawFM would be invalid.

roles.expert_fit: frozen original train/early roles at 10 dB
roles.router_fit: first identity-disjoint half of calibration, all nine paired power views
roles.router_safety_selection: second identity-disjoint half of calibration, all nine paired power views
roles.development_evaluation: tune identities, all nine paired power views

router.advantage_target: expert binary log loss + 0.05 < main binary log loss
router.blend: p_final = p_main + alpha * I(route_probability >= route_threshold) * (p_expert - p_main)

selection.objective: maximize mean MFT/VFT/ISRJ recall at 10 and 50 dB
selection.fallback: alpha=0 (frozen main model) when no candidate is eligible

required_outputs: sample index, receiver_noise_seed, power, labels and thresholds
